details: After I have updated, I had no problem with the game until an hour ago. I tried playing the game and I realized my right controller was not responding. To be fair, the controller works, I could move my right hand and avatar would move, also on the loading screen I could see the buttons I am pressing etc. So the controller definitely works. But when in game, the game copies the buttons from left hand to right hand as well. So if I press the left hand "X" button on Oculus Rift S controller, it mutes the microphone (default action) and jumps (right controller's default action). Also if I do any poses with left hand, it is copied to the right hand too. So I am pretty sure game just copies keybindings from left to right and doesn't execute the correct right keybindings when I press the right controller keys.
title: Right hand buttons not working
